Regex (Regular Expressions)

Quick lookup for regular expression syntax: character classes, anchors, quantifiers, lookarounds, and flags.

Docs
Quick Jump:Character ClassesQuantifiers & AnchorsGroups & Lookaround

Character Classes

Classes
#
.

Matches any single character except newline

\d / \D

Matches any digit [0-9] / non-digit

\w / \W

Matches word character [a-zA-Z0-9_] / non-word

\s / \S

Matches whitespace character (space, tab, newline) / non-space

[a-z0-9]

Character set matching any lowercase letter or digit

[^abc]

Negated set matching any character EXCEPT a, b, or c

Quantifiers & Anchors

Quantifiers
#
^ / $

Matches start of string / end of string

\b

Word boundary anchor

*

0 or more occurrences (greedy)

+

1 or more occurrences (greedy)

?

0 or 1 occurrence, or lazy modifier when after quantifier (*?, +?)

{min,max}

Between min and max repetitions

Groups & Lookaround

Advanced
#
(abc)

Capturing group

(?:abc)

Non-capturing group (does not store capture)

(?<id>\d+)

Named capturing group accessible as groups.id

(?=abc)

Positive lookahead (asserts what follows)

(?!abc)

Negative lookahead (asserts what does not follow)
